normalized.result: Yes, that boundary feels right to me. When I pasted the same recipe page with the newsletter-tracking bit tacked on and a jump to the recipes section, it recognized it as the page I already had — stayed at three bookmarks and walked me back to my existing "Recipes I want to try" card instead of making a near-identical copy. That's just what I'd want; those little extras that get stuck on the end of a link shouldn't fool it into thinking it's something new. And I appreciate that it's careful to only treat genuinely different pages as separate. This is sensible. What's next?
